questions.q: How many patients discontinued the SJ-2041 Phase III trial?
questions.doc: Clinical Site List and Enrolment Status
questions.answer: 92 patients, 7.4% of the 1,240 randomised (as of 30 September 2026).

questions.q: What RPO and RTO does the new NimbusOps DR design target?
questions.doc: Design Doc – NimbusOps Multi-Region Active-Passive DR
questions.evidence: Design targets: RPO of 5 minutes and RTO of 30 minutes.
questions.answer: RPO 5 minutes and RTO 30 minutes, inside the contractual 15 minutes / 1 hour.

questions.q: What RPO and RTO were measured in the April 2026 full DR drill, and did it pass?
questions.answer: The 18 April 2026 full drill measured RPO 6 minutes and RTO 47 minutes and passed.

questions.q: What HbA1c reduction did SJ-2041 show at the Phase III interim analysis?
questions.evidence: HbA1c change from baseline of −1.1% with SJ-2041 versus −0.6% with comparator
questions.answer: −1.1% with SJ-2041 versus −0.6% with the comparator (difference −0.5%), with a dropout rate of 7.4% and 2 serious adverse events judged unrelated.

questions.q: How much does Sanjeevani pay a site for each patient who completes the SJ-2041 trial?
questions.answer: ₹42,000 per completed patient, paid visit by visit, with 10% held back until close-out.

questions.q: Which payment milestone is tied to database lock in the SJ-2041 CRO agreement?
questions.evidence: The M6 payment is the largest milestone at 20% of the fee
questions.answer: Milestone M6: 20% of the ₹18.6 crore fee, ₹3.72 crore, due on database lock (planned 30 November 2026).

questions.q: What is the list price of the NimbusOps Enterprise plan?
questions.answer: USD 5.00 (₹390) per monitored host per month, billed annually.

questions.q: How many days of unused earned leave can a Nimbus employee carry forward into the next year?
questions.evidence: of unused earned leave are carried forward into the next year
questions.answer: Up to 30 days; earned leave beyond 30 days lapses on 31 March.

questions.q: Within how many working days must site QA approve the initial assessment of a major deviation?
questions.evidence: Initial assessment approved by site QA within 3 working days
questions.answer: Within 3 working days, with closure targeted within 30 calendar days.

questions.q: How often must Kaveri re-do KYC for high-risk clients?
questions.doc: KYC and Customer Due Diligence Policy
questions.answer: Every 2 years for high-risk clients.

questions.q: How much extra per month does the active-passive DR design cost?
questions.doc: Design Doc – NimbusOps Multi-Region Active-Passive DR
questions.answer: ₹9.6 lakh per month extra, approved by Pradeep Joshi on 2 June 2026.

questions.q: Where is NimbusOps customer data stored?
questions.evidence: We do not replicate customer data outside India.
questions.answer: In India: AWS ap-south-1 (Mumbai), with disaster recovery in ap-south-2 (Hyderabad); it is never replicated outside India.

questions.q: What is Sanjeevani's FY27 R&D budget and how much of it goes to the SJ-2041 programme?
questions.answer: ₹185 crore in total, of which ₹62 crore (33.5%) is for the SJ-2041 clinical programme.

questions.q: What is the compensation insurance cover for the SJ-2041 trial?
questions.evidence: covers up to ₹10 crore aggregate with ₹50 lakh per participant
questions.answer: Up to ₹10 crore in aggregate, with ₹50 lakh per participant.

questions.q: How often is the full disaster recovery drill held, and when is the next one?
questions.doc: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plan
questions.answer: Twice a year (February and November); the next is due 30 November 2026.

questions.answer: 43 minutes 12 seconds per 30-day month (99.9% monthly availability SLO).
